summary.text: Thomas Johnson is the Democratic candidate for Pennsylvania State Senate District 28 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Kristin Phillips-Hill.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as healthcare consultant.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Johnson advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is running "to help my district for the better and not for corporate gain."
His key messages were affordability, including utility and gas costs, and transparency about the policies being made.
The survey lists the York County Young Democrats as an endorser.
